name: Dirty Knucklebones
summary: Dirty Knucklebones are carried by Crushridge ogres in the Alterac Mountains. Marshal Redpath in Southshore pays a bounty for them to keep the ogres from threatening the foothills.

sections.title: A Marshal’s Bounty
sections.body: Marshal Redpath asks for Dirty Knucklebones from the Crushridge ogres near the ruined city of Alterac. He fears the ogres may press down into the foothills if they feel secure in the ruins. The bones he gathers are meant to keep them away from Southshore, at least for a while.

faq.answer: Crushridge ogres in the Alterac Mountains carry Dirty Knucklebones.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Redpath want them?
faq.answer: Marshal Redpath pays a bounty for the bones to discourage the Crushridge ogres from moving down into the foothills.

faq.q: Where do I bring Dirty Knucklebones?
faq.answer: Bring Dirty Knucklebones to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.
The Crushridge ogres have an ogre mound in the Alterac Mountains near the ruined city of Alterac.
